decisions.reason: A height-adjustable executive desk system needs substantial development and tooling investment, is presented on its own page, and fits the announced focus on flexible workplace solutions, so dropping it would write off a visible commitment.
A chair family is a core, visibly presented line with sunk design and testing costs, and any weak early sales can still be put down to the launch phase.

Floor cushions made from carpets are a small accessory with limited investment, but the product has its own page and ties into the firm's sustainability narrative, so management likely keeps it for now.
The soft sofa sits close to the established upholstery offer and is cheap to keep in the range, although it is only mentioned on the website and so carries little public commitment.
The high standing table is close to the existing offer, is shown on its own page, and supports the flexible office and conference direction, so it is likely retained.

The rug collection is distant from the firm's core, which makes it more vulnerable, but it was just launched with its own page and is likely a designer collaboration, so it is too early to admit a mistake.
